def: to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively)

occurrences.text: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
